96.
(1) No person shall, in any proceedings, be compelled
to divulge whether a victim of crime or witness is receiving
or has received assistance or protection under this Act, unless
it becomes necessary for the purpose of giving effect to the
provisions of this Act or any other written law.
(2)  No  person  shall,  otherwise  than  for  the  purpose  of
giving effect to the provisions of this Act or in compliance
with the provisions of any other written law, divulge to any
other person whether a victim of crime or witness is receiving
or has received assistance or protection under this Act.
